text: Yes, native forest was deforested on this property in 2022. Earth-observation evidence confirms that 0.5 hectares of native forest (out of 0.6 ha total tree-cover loss) within the 17.6 ha asset experienced stand-replacing loss in 2022. The loss was corroborated by multiple independent datasets, including Hansen Global Forest Change and JRC Global Forest Cover 2020, which agreed that the area was forested in 2020. The event meets the territorial definition of deforestation as it involved the clearing of native forest.
